List files using BVFS.

## Synopsis

```text
.bvfs_lsfiles [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [path=<path>] [pathid=<pathid>]
              [limit=<limit>] [offset=<offset>] [pattern=<pattern>]
              [filename=<filename>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Lists the files (without subdirectories) of a directory in the state of a job chain; for each file the version from the newest job of the chain is shown. The FileIds are the input for .bvfs\_restore. The BVFS cache must have been filled with .bvfs\_update first. pattern= keeps only file names matching a regular expression; limit= (default 2000) and offset= page through the result.

Each line has five tab separated columns: PathId, FileId, JobId, LStat and file name.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | string |  |  | list | Job IDs. |
| `path=` | string |  |  |  | Directory. |
| `pathid=` | integer |  |  |  | Path ID. |
| `limit=` | integer |  |  |  | Most rows. |
| `offset=` | integer |  |  |  | Rows to skip. |
| `pattern=` | string |  |  |  | Name filter (regular expression). |
| `filename=` | string |  |  |  | File name. |

## Examples

The files of /etc in a job chain:

```text
.bvfs_lsfiles jobid=600,615,616 path=/etc/
```

Only file names matching a pattern:

```text
.bvfs_lsfiles jobid=600,615,616 pathid=7 pattern=conf
```
